record.question: When filling a prescription for a pregnant mother who has come for an antenatal check-up, which of the following is a crucial counselling point to be given to her?
options: Always take iron and calcium together at the same time
Take only calcium if iron tablets cause abdominal discomfort
Never take calcium and iron at the same time as calcium chelates iron
Take only iron tablet if calcium causes bloating
record.explanation: Official final key: C — Never take calcium and iron at the same time as calcium chelates iron. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 9, printed Q97. The key selects separating calcium and iron doses. The printed mechanistic assertion “calcium chelates iron” is not established by this key; it confirms marking, not that explanation.
